title: Introduction
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.authenticate.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

Authenticate is a verification platform that helps verify individuals through various tests. The SDK allows companies to develop custom applications that utilize these various tests. Currently, we offer solutions for Android, [No-Code Portal](https://portal.authenticating.com/), and the API Suite.

- 🔍 **IDENTITY VERIFICATION**


We use AI, biometrics, and machine learning to verify identities in real-time


across various industries and platforms.
- 👮 **FRAUD PREVENTION**


We help businesses prevent fraudulent transactions and activities by confirming


user identities in real-time.
- 🔐 **COMPLIANCE**


We assist businesses in meeting regulatory requirements like KYC and AML


by offering customizable solutions.
- 🚀 **USER EXPERIENCE**


Our intuitive and non-intrusive identity verification process improves user


retention and conversion rates.
